excerpts.content:
Hello guys, I’m a cryptography researcher attempting to understand the problem of statelessness. 

I came across this paper by Alin Tomescu, et al titled “Aggregatable Subvector Commitments for Stateless Cryptocurrencies”. 

Does anyone know if there is an implementation of this?
